rows.text: Plain words: a group follows a pattern even though one nucleus does not. You will see exactly how in the half-life lesson.
ooh, tiny. and inside one, the nucleus can change all by itself. that's what my lessons are about~
Plain words: matter is anything that has mass and takes up space. Light and heat do not, so they are not matter.
Calm note: unstable does not mean dangerous. Your own body holds a little natural potassium-40, and that is normal.
